notes.title: Mercenaries of War Re-launch is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45060058/5628f2f42a480dda35f4453c7276ef85aac77859.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Mercenaries![/b]

Mercenaries of War has been rebuilt and relaunched with a brand new framework which is a big upgrade from the version I released last year! I look forward to seeing new players and hearing feedback from players.

The original Mercenaries of War framework was built in 2016 with one thing in mind; create a positive hardcore PvP game environment with full development transparency and be actively involved in the player community to create the ultimate hardcore experience together.

I still have a long list of features to implement which can be found on the in-game roadmap and the dev task board on the discord. Suggestions and bug reports can be posted using the in-game feedback systems and discord.

I hope to see you inside, [b]Mercenary[/b]!

[b][url=https://www.mercenariesofwar.com]Website[/url] | [url=https://www.discord.gg/ah7mpNKw7H]Discord[/url][/b]


~ Vyndictus

notes.title: Mercenaries of War v4.0 Relaunch is Almost Here!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings Mercenaries![/b]

I know its been a long rocky road. I am here to announce that Mercenaries of War has been rebuilt from the ground up with more modern technologies than the original framework, allowing for better performance, better capabilities and higher quality visuals. The new build will be launching May 20th, 2025 (Next Tuesday)!

When I started building the original Mercenaries of War framework, I had one thing in mind; create a positive online hardcore PvP game environment with full development transparency and be actively involved in the player community to create the ultimate hardcore experience together. Between in-game feedback systems and our discord server, I want to hear YOUR feedback on we can keep improving, doing better, making it a fun enjoyable albeit hardcore experience. Every player has a voice and I want you to feel heard.

No more round systems, no more wipes, no ads, no paywalls. Just deaths, crew wars and legacies!

Join me as we re-launch a fun hardcore experience, together. 🤘

Discord: [url=https://www.discord.gg/ah7mpNKw7H]https://www.discord.gg/ah7mpNKw7H[/url]

notes.title: We're back!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45060058/5628f2f42a480dda35f4453c7276ef85aac77859.png[/img]

Howdy Mercenaries!

Firstly, I would like to apologize for the silence. Due to personal/family things I had to step away from game dev for a little bit. The server is now online and playable again (and yes, without the annoying hype music lol).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6VaxPgj.png[/img]

We have now started a new round with a fresh database wipe! I will be working on polishing the game in the coming days with new weapons, vehicles and activities. I hope you will join me and the community into building a fun hardcore experience.

[i][b]~ Vyn[/b][/i]

notes.title: Welcome to Round 2!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45060058/46ff7b2774472a6fd811537ad5db83cfbdc72aa7.png[/img]

[h1]Welcome to Round 2![/h1]

Round 2 officially started last weekend in preparation for our Steam launch as a way to continue to build our player base and grow our community on discord. Although the Steam version releases July 1st, you can start playing now by heading to our [url=https://www.mercenariesofwar.net]website[/url].

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/e4jK7Wuj2Y]Discord[/url] and get involved with the community and content development.

This game has been 5 years in development and 2 years in testing. I hope you all enjoy. I will continue to make improvements and respond to feedback through discord, the in-game help desk and bug tracker systems. Thank you!

~ Brian.
